subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Agent Collaboration Enhancement: Capability Profiling + Shared Blackboard + Layered Memory + Token Cost Governance

question: Which scoped path should OpenClaw accept for #35203: a narrow core primitive, plugin/ClawHub-owned optional orchestration, or roadmap-only RFC discussion for now?
rationale: The request spans core agent routing, persisted state, memory visibility, config, cost governance, and security boundaries, and automation cannot choose that product boundary safely.

options.title: Stage a narrow core primitive
options.body: Approve one small first slice, such as capability/run metrics or #65403-style lifecycle work, with explicit security and storage rules before any implementation PR.

options.title: Route optional orchestration to plugins
options.body: Keep core limited to missing extension seams and direct blackboard/orchestration implementations toward plugins or ClawHub unless a core API gap is proven.

options.title: Keep as roadmap only
options.body: Leave the RFC open for design input but decline implementation until the roadmap prioritizes multi-agent collaboration above current setup, stability, and security work.

recommendation.title: Stage a narrow core primitive
recommendation.body: Approve one small first slice, such as capability/run metrics or #65403-style lifecycle work, with explicit security and storage rules before any implementation PR.
